content_sections.heading: About Kalakshetra Foundation Assistant Professor (Bharatanatyam)
content_sections.text: Kalakshetra Foundation is an Institution of National Importance and an autonomous organisation under the Ministry of Culture, Government of India, located in Thiruvanmiyur, Chennai. Rukmini Devi College of Fine Arts (RDCFA) under the Kalakshetra Foundation has published a recruitment notification to fill the post of Assistant Professor (Bharatanatyam) on a deputation or short term contract basis. Eligible candidates must submit their applications to reach the Director, Kalakshetra Foundation by 23-11-2026.

content_sections.text: There is a total of 1 (One) vacancy for the post of Assistant Professor (Bharatanatyam) (Group B) at Rukmini Devi College of Fine Arts.

rows.department: Rukmini Devi College of Fine Arts (RDCFA)

content_sections.heading: Qualification and Experience
content_sections.text: The eligibility criteria differ based on whether a candidate applies for Short Term Contract or Deputation. Eminent artists/private persons fulfilling the essential qualifications as well as having the desirable qualifications, as applicable to a Assistant Professor / Lecturer (Bharatanatyam) level appointee in a Central/State Government/Autonomous institutions. Officers holding analogous posts in Central/State Government/Autonomous institutions, or having 8 years regular service in the Pay Level 15 (Rs. 36200-114800) of Tamil Nadu Government State Pay Scales, or equivalent level. Class X passed. Diploma or Post Diploma holder from a recognised institution in the particular field. Should be able to give solo performance for about 2 hours. Should be able to sing and conduct dance programmes by doing nattuvangam. Should be able to take part in Kalakshetra productions. Should be able to handle all the junior and senior level classes and theory in English. Should have a minimum of 8 years experience in the field. Knowledge of South Indian languages and Hindi. Ability to write music and dance notations.

content_sections.heading: Age Limit
content_sections.text: The maximum age limit for appointment on deputation/short term contract shall not exceed 40 years on the closing date of receipt of application, i.e. 23-11-2026.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: The post carries the scale of pay in Pay Level 16 (Rs 36400-115700) in 7th Pay Commission pay matrix of TN State Pay Scale. The appointment is made on a deputation or short term contract basis.

content_sections.heading: Kalakshetra Foundation Assistant Professor (Bharatanatyam) Job Description
content_sections.text: The responsibilities attached with the post of Assistant Professor (Bharatanatyam) in RDCFA are as follows: To handle Diploma and Post-Diploma practical classes including theory; To complete entire curriculum within the specified time; To assess the learning quality of each student and accordingly supplement additional instructions, if any, as required; To hold regular meetings with parents and guardians and apprise them about the regularity in attendance, ability to learn, progress made in learning and any other relevant information about the child; and To take part in Kalakshetra productions To conduct rehearsals for all the dance dramas To assist in organizing art festivals and other functions throughout the year; To accompany artists in the performances conducted at Kalakshetra and abroad To choreograph dance dramas To provide guidance for Costume Department in designing costumes for dance dramas To coordinate with Dance section in organizing art festivals and other celebrations at Kalakshetra; To conduct rehearsals for all dance-dramas in co-ordination with dance section; To perform such other duties as may be prescribed by the Principal or by the administration of the Kalakshetra Foundation.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Based on the scrutiny of applications, candidates who fulfil the Essential Qualifications in all respects as per the parameters of this Notice will be shortlisted, and such shortlisted candidates may be called for a skill test, if necessary.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Kalakshetra Foundation Assistant Professor (Bharatanatyam)
content_sections.text: Applications complete in all respects as per the prescribed proforma as given in Annexure I to this Notice should be submitted to Director, Kalakshetra Foundation, Thiruvanmiyur, Chennai 600041 so as to reach by 5.30 p.m. on 23-11-2026. In case of serving officials, it may be ensured that necessary documents viz. cadre clearance, vigilance clearance, copy of APARs (for the last five years) are invariably sent through proper channel. The cover containing the application should be clearly superscribed as “Application for the Post of Assistant Professor (Bharatanatyam), Rukmini Devi College of Fine Arts”.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Application form with recent passport size photo (Pl. Check whether all columns have been filled in and signed by the applicant) One passport size photo (extra) in a cover Copy of Aadhar Proof of all educational qualifications mentioned in the Application Proof for age Testimonials for teaching/working experience Caste Certificate if age relaxation is claimed Certificate of disability if age relaxation is claimed for Physically challenged. Other relevant certificates/testimonials regarding essential qualification and desirable qualification Relevant document for provision of a scribe, if required. For serving officials: Cadre clearance, vigilance clearance, copy of APARs (for the last five years) sent through proper channel, and Annexure-II certificate.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Incomplete applications or applications received after the last date will be summarily rejected.
